'''Jannor-Cel''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A dark skinned Human [[Gender/Legends|male]] with black [[Hair/Legends|hair]] tied back in a knot and [[brown]] eyes, he was one of many of his [[Species/Legends|species]] who settled on Taris. A fluent speaker of [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], Jannor-Cel wore [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for protection from the world's wildlife. He sold crafting equipment from his shop in [[Olaris]], the headquarters of the Republic-sponsored [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jannor-Cel was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. He appears on the Republic version of Taris as a Crew Skills Vendor in Olaris.<ref name="TOR" />
